class Instruments.network_manager.NetworkManager(non_default_program_path=None, non_default_instrument_ports=None, rm=pyvisa.ResourceManager)[source]¶

Bases: object

__init__(non_default_program_path=None, non_default_instrument_ports=None, rm=pyvisa.ResourceManager)[source]¶

Initialize the NetworkManager to handle setting up instruments and establishing VISA connections.

Params non_default_program_path:

path to a json file containing non-default program paths for instruments. If None, internal default will be used

Parameters:

  • non_default_instrument_ports (string) – string - path to a json file containing non-default instrument ports. If None, internal default will be used

  • rm (pyvisa.ResourceManager) – pyvisa.ResourceManager - Resource manager to use for instrument connections. If None, a new resource manager will be created.
